unitTitle: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood
title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 6: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the learner's needs, the details in each listing and the question that remains unanswered. A good comparison uses evidence from the notice instead of guessing about a home.

steps.title: Two rental options
steps.body: Lina asks her classmate Karim to help compare two fictional listings.

examples.fr: J'ai deux annonces. Le studio est moins cher, mais l'appartement d'une chambre est plus près du train.
examples.en: Lina: I have two listings. The studio is less expensive, but the one-bedroom is closer to the train.
Karim: What is your maximum budget?

examples.fr: Mille quatre cents dollars par mois, avec les frais d'électricité.
examples.en: Lina: One thousand four hundred dollars a month, including electricity costs.

examples.fr: Le studio coûte mille trois cent cinquante dollars. Les charges sont comprises.
examples.en: Karim: The studio costs thirteen hundred and fifty dollars. Utilities are included.

examples.fr: Il coûte mille quatre cent cinquante dollars. Il a un balcon privé et plus d'espace de rangement.
examples.en: Karim: It costs fourteen hundred and fifty dollars. It has a private balcony and more storage space.

examples.fr: Je préfère un quartier paisible et un trajet court. Le studio est aussi près de la bibliothèque.
examples.en: Lina: I prefer a peaceful neighbourhood and a short trip. The studio is also close to the library.

examples.fr: Donc, visite les deux et vérifie le coût mensuel avant de choisir.
examples.en: Karim: So visit both and check the monthly cost before choosing.

steps.title: Ask before you sign
steps.body: Nadia phones a housing contact to clarify a listing.

examples.fr: Bonjour. Je téléphone au sujet du logement meublé près du centre communautaire.
examples.en: Nadia: Hello. I am calling about the furnished home near the community centre.
Contact: Yes. What is your question?
Nadia: Is the laundry room in the building?

examples.fr: Oui, elle est au sous-sol. La laveuse et la sécheuse sont dans la buanderie.
examples.en: Contact: Yes, it is in the basement. The washer and dryer are in the laundry room.

examples.fr: Le stationnement intérieur est-il compris dans le loyer ?
examples.en: Nadia: Is indoor parking included in the rent?

examples.fr: Non. Il y a un coût mensuel en plus.
examples.en: Contact: No. There is an extra monthly cost.

examples.fr: Merci. Je vais visiter le logement samedi et lire les conditions avant de signer un bail.
examples.en: Nadia: Thank you. I am going to visit the home Saturday and read the conditions before signing a lease.

examples.fr: Très bien. Le logement est moins bruyant le matin que le soir.
examples.en: Contact: Very good. The home is less noisy in the morning than in the evening.

options: The notices do not give a price
steps.explain: Karim says the studio costs $1,350, while the one-bedroom costs $1,450.

steps.prompt: What matters to Lina besides the monthly budget?
options: A peaceful neighbourhood and a short trip
A private garage and a large garden
steps.explain: Lina says she prefers a peaceful neighbourhood and a short trip.

steps.prompt: Where are the washer and dryer?
options: In a shared room in the basement
steps.explain: The contact says they are in a shared room in the basement.

steps.prompt: What extra cost is not included in Nadia's rent?
steps.explain: The contact says indoor parking costs extra each month.
